export_nerf_transforms: export NeRF transforms from input path with camera poses, intrinsics, and masked images to nerfstudio convention
create_smooth_video: create a smooth mp4 and gif video from sorted rendered images with alternating or interleaving sort order
combine_all_steps: combine all step-wise NeRF transforms into a single unified transforms.json with copied images and masks
convert_to_sdfstudio: convert exported nerfstudio-format transforms to sdfstudio format for each processed step
run_export_cli: run the export_nerf_transforms CLI module with tyro to export NeRF data from input directory to output path
